message: You know that feeling when you finally test your smoke alarms and they actually work? I felt a bit smug as I reminded my family about our escape plan at dinner, and then my daughter casually said, "Yeah, Dad, we kind of know it by heart now." 😂 It’s nice to know that being prepared doesn’t just keep us safe, but also gives us some family bonding moments! What little safety rituals do you have at home?
